as "Lessee", collectively referred to herein as the "Parties", agree as follows:

## 1. DESCRIPTION OF LEASED PREMISES:

The Lessor agrees to lease to the Lessee the following described 7480 square feet (SF) of Warehouse located at

59958 3rd Avenue [street address], State of California.

## 2. TERM OF LEASE:

The term of this Lease shall be for a period of 1 year(s) 0 month(s) commencing on the

1 day of June 2025 day of June 2025, and expiring at Midnight on the 1 day of

June 2026 day of June 2026. ("Initial Term")

## 3. BASE RENT:

The net monthly payment shall be 9993 dollars ($9993) per month. A security deposit of 5324 dollars ($5324)

is required. payable monthly with the first payment due upon the is required. payable monthly with the first payment due upon the commencement of the Lease and each monthly installment payable thereafter on the 1st day of each month
